reliability_gate.rule: Operationally reliable iff, for EACH model, fallbacks <= 20/400 (5.0%) overall AND <= 10/100 in every direction. Declared before the rerun; operational only, never a quality criterion. COMET is not used to accept or reject the revised contract.
reliability_gate.single_revision: One contract revision only. No prompt iteration after observing the full rerun. If the gate fails, the PI decides: retain as explicit failure condition or remove.
